method: Two 180-second seeded outgoing-only simulations per class using real MonsterSystem/AttackCycle/skill/projectile/scheduled effect/poison paths. Harmonic HP-weighted DPS combines the upper65% and execute35% of HP.

assumptions.rareEquipment: Highest existing compatible rare items at or below42; all actual item IDs are recorded,not added to user saves.
assumptions.attributes: 165 points earned through55 real level-ups:110 to the recorded primary and55 endurance; starting attributes remain5.
assumptions.skills: All five existing skills learned to rank5 through learnSkill; exactly four assigned buttons. One eligible skill input per650ms; held basic attack continues.
assumptions.mana: Finite natural pool and five MP potions per 180-second phase; real45% restoration and shared3-second cooldown. Actual combat regeneration is used; no artificial mana refill.
assumptions.dummy: Giant defense/magicDefense preserved. Enemy AI,damage and knockback movement disabled by a stationary test floor; hero dash/backstab and real projectiles still execute.
assumptions.uptimeMeaning: Post-simulation assumption for dodging/positioning. It does not simulate incoming attacks,moving penalties,missed AoEs,phase invulnerability or real player survival.

limitations: Short phase samples cannot prove continuous30-minute resource sustain.
Outgoing-only calibration is not a solo victory or a30-minute real encounter.
The two health-phase samples are separate resource simulations; five potions reset only between explicitly separate samples,never during either sample.
The rare level42 loadout and attribute allocation are proposed fixtures,not owner-approved typical builds.
No physical Android,FPS,network,multiplayer or incoming survival claim.
